concept: Late-night solo build: blue-lit isolation → iterative friction → piece-by-piece assembly → 2 a.m. quiet click → vindication. Visual arc mirrors a maker staring at a broken machine until it finally runs.

narrative_arc.title: THE LONG NIGHT
visual_drivers: Blue light only — cold indigo atmosphere
Lyrics float like thoughts in empty room
lyric_hooks: Blue light's the only thing still awake in here
Everyone else went home hours ago

narrative_arc.title: FRICTION
lyric_hooks: Now there's frost outside and I'm still stuck between
Every time I fix one thing, something else gives out

narrative_arc.title: ASSEMBLY
visual_drivers: Spectrum bars resolve from noise to shape
lyric_hooks: Piece by piece - piece by piece - watch it grow
I've rebuilt the same idea a dozen times

narrative_arc.title: THE CLICK
visual_drivers: Warm gold-red ignition — the quiet breakthrough
Beat flash softens to sustained bloom
Orb holds steady glow, ring expands once
lyric_hooks: I felt that click at two in the morning light
Nobody claps when something quietly works right

narrative_arc.title: ARRIVAL
visual_drivers: Orange-gold vindication — every hour meant exactly this
Spectrum full, bars smooth and confident
lyric_hooks: Every quiet hour will have meant exactly what it seemed
It finally works, and it was worth it
